referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A wide cityscape banner with centered firm introduction leads into three slim value columns before the page turns into long service and people chapters. Narrow white row with small firm emblem, subdued legal-topic links, contact route and search. Compact uppercase sans section labels, restrained gray body copy and centered chapter headings. The page sequence runs from firm navigation to cityscape introduction to three-value overview toward latest-news cards, podcast band, contact footer. Cityscape first, then legal-work and meeting photographs beside text; brochure mockup and practitioner portraits are later proof devices. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.

mobileRecomposition.strategy: Stack the three value columns, move image above its linked copy, and keep legal resources separate from the actual consultation path.
